youtube.title: One ad, four sizes in 3 steps: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5 from one shot list
youtube.description:
One ad, four sizes: 3 steps. Write the shot list once, add one formats line, render.
Every size gets its own text audit: each caption checked byte for byte. This Short rendered in under 50 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.

x.text:
One ad, four sizes, 3 steps:

1. Write the shot list once
2. Add one line: "formats": 9x16, 16x9, 1x1, 4x5
3. Render: four videos, each caption checked byte for byte

Runs on your own computer. IsraelWebDev/funkbox
